scope: All triangles of all 47 owned source meshes; unique planar polygon charts. Metric is base-level effective texel density, not screen resolution or streamed mip residency.
island_strategy: One chart per authored polygon; no shared charts. Per-polygon area normalization preserves target mean density; curved/non-planar triangle deviation measured.
padding_note: At least 8 effective base texels per side, increased to virtual atlas side/1024 to avoid UE static-mesh UV vertex welding. Surface image is intentionally repeating; virtual atlas is not a unique baked color image.
